maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring software subscriptions for payroll and HR platforms, sold to businesses, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private employers such as boutiques, franchises, manufacturers and sports teams, paying for HR and payroll software.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own HCM platform; acquisitions such as Airbase are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Core payroll, tax filing and HR system; switching means data migration, retraining, and payroll accuracy and compliance risk.
